title: Understanding Different Types of Kernel Functions for Machine Learning

cues.en: Instructor: Hello and welcome back to the course on Machine Learning.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回到機器學習課程。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed the previous tutorials.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡前面的教學。

cues.en: And today we're going to talk about the different types of kernel functions.
cues.zh: 今天要談不同類型的核心函數。

cues.en: So the final thing that you need to know about the kernel SVM is that the radial basis function, which also called the Gaussian function,
cues.zh: 關於核心 SVM，最後還要知道的是，徑向基底函數，也稱為高斯函數，

cues.en: is a not the only kernel function that is used in this method.
cues.zh: 並不是這個方法中唯一使用的核心函數。

cues.en: So let's have a look at a couple.
cues.zh: 看幾個例子。

cues.en: So here we've got the Gaussian or the RBF kernel, which we've already spoken about.
cues.zh: 這裡是之前談過的高斯核心，也就是 RBF 核心。

cues.en: Then there's also a popular choice, which is a sigmoid kernel, and that's a formula on the right.
cues.zh: 另一個熱門選擇是 sigmoid 核心，右邊就是公式。

cues.en: It's in a bit of a different notation, but the essence is the same, is that you still select a landmark and then from there,
cues.zh: 使用的符號稍有不同，但本質相同，仍然先選一個地標，再從那裡，

cues.en: depending on the distance of landmark, different results will occur.
cues.zh: 根據到地標的距離產生不同結果。

cues.en: But in this case, as you can see, this kernel function is directional.
cues.zh: 不過可以看到，這個核心函數有方向性。

cues.en: So anything, even like just looking at it in this two dimensional spaces, just a projection, you can see that anything to the right will be automatically right away
cues.zh: 即使只看這個二維空間的投影，也能看到右邊所有內容會立即、自動

cues.en: will have a high value, so will be included in your classification.
cues.zh: 得到高值，因此納入你的分類。

cues.en: Anything to the left will be excluded.
cues.zh: 左邊的則會被排除。

cues.en: So sometimes you might require these situations.
cues.zh: 有時你可能需要這樣的情況。

cues.en: So maybe if you look at a two dimensional space, just imagine those points that we had, points on one side are not in your classification.
cues.zh: 例如在二維空間，想像先前的那些點，一側的點不屬於你的分類，

cues.en: On the other side are in your classification, you want to somehow outline that decision boundary or highlight that.
cues.zh: 另一側則屬於，你想以某種方式勾勒或突顯決策邊界。

cues.en: So points past a certain point are, should be in your classification.
cues.zh: 也就是超過某個位置的點應該歸入分類。

cues.en: Then a sigmoid kernel is a popular choice.
cues.zh: 那麼 sigmoid 核心就是熱門選擇。

cues.en: Also, we've got polynomial kernels, which are also popular, one of the more popular choices.
cues.zh: 還有多項式核心，也是很熱門的選擇之一。

cues.en: And here you can have like a polynome, which dictates how your kernel behaves.
cues.zh: 這裡可以用多項式決定核心的行為。

cues.en: And again, you can go into more detail on that.
cues.zh: 同樣，你也可以深入研究。

cues.en: So this tutorial is not for us to discuss the specifics of each one of these kernels, but just to show you that they exist
cues.zh: 這堂不是要討論每種核心的具體細節，而是讓你知道它們存在，

cues.en: and help you be aware of the different types.
cues.zh: 並認識不同類型。

cues.en: And so these are the most popular choices like Gaussian, RBF, sigmoid, and Polynomial.
cues.zh: 這些就是最熱門的選擇，例如高斯，也就是 RBF，以及 sigmoid 和多項式。

cues.en: Hope you enjoyed learning about the kernel SVM, and I look forward to you next time.
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡學習核心 SVM，期待下次見到你。

cues.en: Until then, happy analyzing.
cues.zh: 在此之前，分析愉快。
